entries.0178a61738244ac1: This business manufactures and sells ethylene, propylene, polyethylene, polypropylene, catalysts, phenols, high-purity terephthalic acid, PET resins, polyurethane materials and industrial chemicals. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥599,922 million (down 15.5% year on year), the largest of the four reportable segments. The decline in consolidated revenue is attributed to lower selling prices following falling raw material prices such as naphtha, and to lower sales volume in this business. Sales of phenols decreased from the previous year. Naphtha cracker operating rates were low, reflecting lower demand for downstream products and the impact of large-scale periodic maintenance. Principal affiliates in this business are Prime Polymer Co., Ltd., Prime Evolue Singapore Pte. Ltd. and Kumho Mitsui Chemicals, Inc., and 19 other companies are also engaged in this business. The company transferred all of its interest in Shanghai SECCO Mitsui Chemicals Co., Ltd. (SSMC) to Sinopec Shanghai Gaoqiao Petrochemical Co., Ltd., and excluded it from the scope of equity-method application for this business.

entries.22653db514bf75bd: This business manufactures and sells semiconductor and electronic component process materials, optical materials, nonwoven fabrics, lithium-ion and next-generation battery materials, and high-performance food packaging materials. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥279,436 million (up 0.7% year on year), an increase despite the transfer of subsidiary shares. Sales of semiconductor and optical materials and ICT films and sheets were firm, reflecting a recovery in demand in the semiconductor market. Sales of coating and functional materials were roughly on par with the previous year, while sales of nonwoven fabrics declined from the previous year. Principal affiliates are Honshu Chemical Industry Co., Ltd., Mitsui Chemicals ICT Materials Co., Ltd., M.A. Life Materials Co., Ltd., Asahi Kasei Spunbond (Thailand) Co., Ltd., Mitsui-Chemours Fluoro Products Co., Ltd. and RM Tocello Co., Ltd.; 16 other companies are also involved in this business. Following the organizational restructuring on April 1, 2025, the reportable segments to which M.A. Life Materials Co., Ltd. and certain other consolidated subsidiaries belong were reviewed, and comparisons with the previous fiscal year have been restated to reflect the revised segment classifications.

entries.4d8cabafc3fc1889: Revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,668,754 million, a decrease of 7.8% from the previous year. External customer revenue was ¥599,922 million for Basic & Green Materials, ¥515,406 million for Mobility Solutions, ¥279,436 million for ICT Solutions, ¥259,076 million for Life & Healthcare Solutions, and ¥14,914 million for Other. Together, the four [[term:segment|reportable segments]] and 'Other' make up consolidated revenue. The decrease is due to lower selling prices resulting from lower raw material prices such as naphtha, and to lower sales in Basic & Green Materials, among other factors. The company states that revenue fluctuates with sales volume and selling prices, and that selling prices are affected by the extent to which raw material and fuel costs such as naphtha are passed on to product prices, by product market conditions, by currency fluctuations and other factors.
entries.5aa87acaad1b6410: The competitive advantages the company cites for each business area are as follows. Vision care materials: a product lineup and supply capacity that can respond to broad customer needs and growing demand, and global brand strength. Elastomer polymer products: a broad materials lineup, high technological capability and quality, and a broad customer base built on its global network. Semiconductor and packaging solutions: high technological capability in products from front-end processes to back-end and packaging areas, and a robust production system. Petrochemical products: naphtha crackers with world-class competitiveness, and polyolefin catalyst technology, including metallocene.

entries.685178bedf70d6b6: This business manufactures and sells vision care materials, oral care materials, personal care materials and agricultural chemicals. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥259,076 million (up 2.9% year on year). Sales of vision care materials for eyeglass lenses and agricultural chemicals were firm, and sales of oral care materials were roughly on par with the previous year. The company describes its vision care materials as products with the world's top market share. Principal affiliates are Mitsui Chemicals Crop & Life Solutions, Inc., Mitsui Chemicals Fine Co., Ltd. and Kulzer GmbH; 54 other companies are also involved in this business.

entries.8fee574e3de83842: This business manufactures and sells elastomers, functional compounds and polypropylene compounds, and also provides new product development support for industrial products such as automobiles (Solutions Business). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥515,406 million (down 7.2% year on year). Revenue for this business declined due to the transfer of subsidiary shares, among other factors. Sales of elastomers were roughly on par with the previous year. Sales of polypropylene compounds declined from the previous year due to production cuts by OEM manufacturers caused by U.S. tariffs, semiconductor supply shortages and a fire at a U.S. aluminum plant. Sales in the Solutions Business also declined from the previous year. Principal affiliates are Ark Co., Ltd., ARRK Engineering GmbH, Mitsui Elastomers Singapore Pte. Ltd., Grand Siam Composites Co.,Ltd., Advanced Composites,Inc., Advanced Composites Mexicana S.A. de C.V. and Shanghai Sinopec Mitsui Elastomers Co., Ltd.; 26 other companies are also involved in this business.

entries.bf086c1fe4c4a569: Under its long-term management plan 'VISION 2030', formulated in fiscal 2021, the company aims to realize 'a recycling-oriented society in harmony with the environment', 'a comfortable society where people can live with health and peace of mind', and 'an inclusive society that creates diverse value'. The company states that it will apply 'social issue perspective', 'solution-based business model', 'circular economy business model' and 'digital transformation (DX)' across the whole company and all businesses, aiming to shift away from the conventional materials-supply business and to build its management and business foundations. Its basic policies include accelerating the transformation of its business portfolio by allocating resources heavily to areas and regions where high profitability is expected, and strengthening the competitiveness and greening of its industrial complexes through alliances and reorganization with other companies.
